capabilities: cover every file-explorer folder except the one containing the active note
toggle the cover via a toolbar button or a command-palette command
drag sibling folders into a custom order in a dedicated reorder mode
configure what stays readable (ancestor folders, subfolders, auto-collapse)
disambiguation: A visual cover for the file explorer, not encryption; folder names stay readable in the page and other views like search and quick switcher are untouched.
extras: Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later, works on mobile, and ships English plus Simplified and Traditional Chinese interfaces with more translations linked.
motivation: The README lists why: focus in large vaults, presenting one project in a meeting, and screen recordings that should not reveal other folders.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer always shows the whole vault tree, which distracts or leaks other projects' names on shared screens, and folder order can only be changed by renaming with number prefixes.
summary: File explorer add-on that covers every folder except the current one for focus or screen sharing, and lets you drag sibling folders into a custom order.
